2608.07417.title: I Seek You in Videos: Identity-Conditioned Queries for Person-Centric Video Reasoning
2608.07417.paper_summary: Real-world video reasoning often involves multimodal, multi-source inputs, whereas existing video reasoning tasks typically assume a simplified video-text setting, limiting identity matching and person-centric reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Identity-conditioned Queries (ICQ) task, in which models are required to jointly associate and interpret an input video and a reference image of a person, and leverage this conditioning to address identity grounding, behavior understanding, and temporal reasoning, among other challenges. Building on ICQ, we present ISYV (I Seek You in Videos), a systematic solution comprising three components: (1) ISYV-Bench, a challenging evaluation benchmark with 1,377 real-world complex videos and 1,377 question-answer pairs, organized into six difficulty levels spanning capabilities from identity recognition to causal reasoning; (2) ISYV-75K, a large-scale training set of 75K high-quality samples constructed via automated annotation, multi-stage verification, and manual review; and (3) ISYV-Framework, containing an ICQ-oriented model and training strategy for learning to exploit informative video shots without additional shot-level annotations. Extensive experiments show that both mainstream closed-source and open-source MLLMs struggle on ISYV-Bench, especially in cross-domain identity matching and long-horizon tracking. ISYV-Model outperforms strong baselines and in some aspects approaches closed-source performance. Overall, ISYV provides a unified task definition, scalable datasets/benchmarks, and modeling insights for person-centric video reasoning.
2608.07417.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界中的視頻推理通常涉及多模態、多來源的輸入，而現有的視頻推理任務通常假設簡化的視頻-文本設置，限制了身份匹配和以人為中心的推理。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了身份條件查詢（ICQ）任務，該任務要求模型共同關聯和解釋輸入視頻和一個人的參考圖像，並利用這一條件來解決身份基礎、行為理解和時間推理等挑戰。在ICQ的基礎上，我們提出了ISYV（I Seek You in Videos），這是一個系統化的解決方案，包括三個組件：（1）ISYV-Bench，一個具有挑戰性的評估基準，包含1,377個現實世界的複雜視頻和1,377對問題-答案，分為六個難度級別，涵蓋從身份識別到因果推理的能力；（2）ISYV-75K，一個大型訓練集，包含75K高質量樣本，通過自動標註、多階段驗證和人工審查構建；（3）ISYV-Framework，包含一個以ICQ為導向的模型和訓練策略，用於學習在沒有額外鏡頭級標註的情況下利用信息豐富的視頻片段。大量實驗表明，主流的閉源和開源MLLM在ISYV-Bench上表現不佳，特別是在跨領域身份匹配和長期跟蹤方面。ISYV-Model超越了強基準，在某些方面接近閉源性能。總體而言，ISYV提供了一個統一的任務定義、可擴展的數據集/基準和以人為中心的視頻推理的建模見解。
